objective: Create and verify a palindrome module with two disjoint local agents.

context.objective: Produce an implementation, an independent test suite, and a structured local review.

authoritativeSources.label: Interface Contract
authoritativeSources.content:
Target module: examples/workspace_demo/is_palindrome_module.py
Target tests: examples/workspace_demo/test_is_palindrome_module.py

Implement def is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool that ignores case and non-alphanumeric characters.

constraints: Create a missing text file with old set to an empty string.
Do not emit or execute commands.
rejectionCriteria: An edit touches paths outside the task allowlist.
The implementation and tests disagree with the frozen interface.
The review is not exact JSON.
context.outputProtocol: Return only the artifact required by the task contract.

tasks.prompt: Create the module with one edit whose old value is empty and whose new value is the complete file.
tasks.interfaceContract: The module exports def is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool and ignores case plus non-alphanumeric characters.

tasks.prompt: Create the pytest module with one edit whose old value is empty and whose new value covers empty, mixed-case, punctuated, true, and false cases.
tasks.interfaceContract: Tests import is_palindrome and assert the same case-insensitive, non-alphanumeric-normalizing behavior.

tasks.prompt: Review the applied implementation, tests, and passing integration evidence. Return verdict, findings, and summary.
tasks.interfaceContract: Approve only when implementation and tests satisfy the frozen is_palindrome interface.
